title: Store 1 Applied Operational Learning Record
description: Schema for GovMem Store 1 applied records. These records exist only after an operator has approved a Store 1 delta candidate through the apply gate (tools/govmem/store1_apply.py). Records are file-backed, scoped to a single agent, and never shared mutably with peer agents. Only sentinel_overwatch provenance may become Store 1 operational truth. This file-backed Store 1 path is not live runtime memory.

store.description: Always 'store_1'. Identifies this as an applied operational learning record.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the applied record format.

target_agent_id.description: Agent this record belongs to. Must be a safe path component. Records live only under agents/<target_agent_id>/.

target_agent_role.description: Role of the target agent, or 'unknown'.

agent_scope.description: Always 'agent_local'. Agents cannot overwrite each other's Store 1.

shared_with_peer_agents.description: Must always be false. Store 1 is per-agent and never shared mutably across agents.

shared_with_abigail.description: Whether a read-view copy was written to the Abigail aggregation namespace.

source_delta_id.description: source_record_id of the Store 1 delta candidate this record was applied from.

source_store2_run_id.description: Run ID of the Store 2 batch the candidate was derived from.

sentinel_source.description: Only sentinel_overwatch provenance may be applied. heuristic_simulation and legacy_no_source are rejected at the write gate.

level.description: Severity level. D is highest risk.

approved_by_operator.description: Must be true. The apply gate refuses any record without operator approval.

approval_id.description: Approval ID from the operator approval manifest.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of operator approval, from the manifest.

operational_effect.description: Human-readable description of what this record changes for the target agent.

memory_action.description: Operational memory action, from the candidate's recommended_memory_action.

sentinel_action.description: Operational sentinel action, from the candidate's recommended_sentinel_action.

haap_requirement.description: HAAP requirement, from the candidate's recommended_haap_requirement.

confidence_delta.description: Confidence adjustment. 0.0 at initial apply; tuned by future governed corrections only.

expiration.description: ISO 8601 UTC expiration timestamp, or null if the record does not expire.

review_after.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the record should be re-reviewed, or null.

rollback_id.description: ID of a prior record this record replaces, or null. Reserved for a future rollback tool.

abigail_training_eligible.description: Must always be false. Abigail training requires a separate governed approval path.

abigail_training_requires_approval.description: Abigail training always requires explicit operator approval.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the apply gate wrote this record.

source_file.description: Absolute path to the Store 1 delta candidates JSONL this record was applied from.
